title: ARA production overview
description: Is production OK right now? Traces from service ara-webapp (the Rails app behind arariichi.org), host metrics from the otel-hostmetrics collector, container stats from docker_stats. The hourly crawler burst shows here as a 429 spike; it used to be a 504 spike at the proxy.

widgets.description: Server spans per minute, all routes

service.name = 'ara-webapp' AND kind_string = 'Server' AND response_status_code >= '300' AND response_status_code < '400'

service.name = 'ara-webapp' AND kind_string = 'Server' AND http.route != '/up' AND response_status_code != '429'
